title: Provider-local exact-authority fast reuse
motivation: F-AHL28A removed deep-copy cost but warm bind remains about 0.39 microseconds because every bind reconstructs sampler state, exact cache key and performs a shared-cache lookup. F-AHL28 proved FMR currently performs one such acquisition per adaptive physical advance.

repair.table_ownership: retain F-AHL28A immutable shared-cache table borrowing
repair.provider_local_identity: store exact initialized coefficient bits and ksatexm extension state alongside an already acquired table
repair.fast_reuse: when the same provider instance is rebound against bit-identical hydraulic authority and policy, rebind only the analytical fallback for the current step duration and reuse the already-associated immutable table
repair.changed_authority: fall through to the existing exact-key cache acquisition path
repair.step_duration: never used to validate table identity; analytical fallback is rebound every call because h>-1 capacity semantics remain step-duration dependent

qualification.warm_bind: median warm rebind must be at least 50% faster than the original F-AHL28 baseline of 5.82725e-7 s
qualification.shared_cache_accounting: provider-local repeated rebinds with unchanged authority must not increment shared-cache hits after first acquisition
qualification.changed_key: a bitwise coefficient or extension change must bypass fast reuse and acquire/build the correct representation
qualification.matrix: prescribed-head 12/12 PASS with identical nonlinear/backtracking routes
qualification.fallbacks: qbot and accepted-trajectory analytical fallback PASS
qualification.application_timing: repeat F-AHL27 reference-floor paired timing with unchanged <0.98 PASS gate
